findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

The test strips available for CL sanitizers are observed discolored. They are also not functioning correctly when used. The PIC was shown and discarded the test strips during this inspection. They then acquired new strips during the inspection to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that test strips in the facility function correctly at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Dust accumulation is observed on the vent cover in the walk in cooler. The PIC is instructed to clean and maintain this clean at all times moving forward to prevent dust flying into foods in the cooler. Ensure that all physical facilities are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C).

A gallon of milk in the walk in cooler is observed partially used and without a date mark. Per the PIC it was opened yesterday for use in mac n’ cheese. Date marking was discussed and a date placed on the milk to correct.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed. 

The bottle of test strips (for sanitizer concentration) is observed stored in a container in contact with the food contact surface of batter mixers. A conversation was conducted with the PIC and the mixer was moved to dish for cleaning. The outside of test strip containers is not cleaned/sanitized and should not be in contact with any food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The bucket of sanitizer in the area next to the walk in cooler is using a quat based sanitizer that would not register on inspector or facility test strips. Bucket was remade using bleach to correct concentrations.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Buckets of sanitizer and soapy water observed unlabeled. Label working containers so that contents are apparent. CORRECTED- Containers labeled to indicate contents.
7-102.11: Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114  (P) Quaternary ammonium sanitizer measured <100 ppm in the back prep area. Sanitizer bucket for wiping tables was observed at a concentration of 100ppm. Maintain concentration at 200 ppm to 400 ppm as indicated on manufacturer's label. Solutions was remade at the proper concentration.
Make sure wiping clothes are properly submerged in solution between uses.
